method: Separate post-draft reading against final source, core and regression receipts, in-place raw validators and returned independent reviews
score_reason: Specific names and measured results keep the prose concrete. Protocol headings and checklist tables create some formal repetition appropriate to this record.
confidence_reason: Editorial self-assessment, not an independent human rating.

examples.impact: Records contrary evidence without preserving an unsupported bug claim.
examples.quote: | Suspected missing authority-free prompt | Added a direct prompt assertion. It passed before code changes; R's indexed assignment expands the NULL ID vector to NA values. The reviewer retracted the finding. | False positive, regression assertion retained. |

science_gate_reason: Separates review access, mapping identity, resolution coverage and biological correctness; states unadjudicated cases and provider limits.
facts_gate_reason: Numbers and statuses compared with final aggregate receipts, test outputs, source/archive binding and independent review messages. Proposed/deferred work is labelled.
references_gate_reason: Local source and evidence links checked in the task directory; source identities and exact hashes are recorded. The paper-specific evidence is in separately assessed TNRS-DESIGN.md.
calibration_status: Protocol examples already seen; no held-out calibration or authorship inference.
